info.name: Microsoft Word JavaScript API
info.description:
RESTful representation of the Office JavaScript API for Word add-ins. This API provides strongly-typed objects for document manipulation, content controls, tables, formatting, comments, collaboration, and shapes within Word documents through the Office Add-ins platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Office Add-ins Support
